T The Second Plate Some meals bring you back 2026

The first plate is just the start. The second plate is the commitment: to return, continue and build with belief. The brand is built by young Nepali minds, slowly and patiently, plate by plate. Tagline: Where the Second Plate Begins.

Calm, confident and optimistic. Copy follows four patterns: cause and effect, contrast, motivation, and short lines like 'One more plate.' Words to use: build, return, continue, grow. Words to avoid: overhype, rush, loud.

A bowl shaped mark in one red (#C62026) with black and off white, set in Value Serif Pro. Imagery stays warm and human: food, hands and the motion of serving.

Signage, packaging, cups, receipts, aprons and staff tees, each carrying a line from the voice: 'Always ready for your Second Plate.'
